coding_or_terminal: a computer screen showing source code in an IDE or code editor
a computer screen showing a terminal, logs, debugging, or command-line work
web_browsing: a computer screen showing a web browser, website, or web application
a computer screen showing online search, documentation, or browser tabs
paper_or_document: a computer screen showing a research paper, PDF, notes, or technical document
a computer screen showing writing, reading, or document editing
training_monitoring: a computer screen showing machine learning metrics, charts, or experiment monitoring
a computer screen showing a training run, dashboard, notebook output, or evaluation results
file_or_desktop: a computer desktop, file manager, settings panel, or application launcher
a computer screen showing folders, files, windows, or operating-system controls
communication: a computer screen showing email, chat, messaging, or a discussion interface
a computer screen showing a video meeting or team collaboration application
other_screen_work: a desktop software interface being actively used for professional work
a computer screen showing a graphical application not covered by the other labels
non_screen_or_idle: a photograph or camera video without a visible computer interface

score_contract.activity_score: cosine similarity between normalized image and prompt-ensemble embeddings
score_contract.activity_relative_probability: softmax over this closed label set at temperature 0.05; not calibrated
score_contract.activity_margin: top cosine similarity minus runner-up cosine similarity
